REQUIREMENTS_ANALYSIS.PROJECT_GOAL: Provide the MAG8000-LTE 4G communication module for MAG8000 Transmitter with the functionality specified in feature specification baseline 4.

SYSTEM_INTERACTION.PURPOSE: adr-10353: Mag8000 web APP will trigger GET_PARAMETER command in order to get all needed parameter.
adr-10341: The module will send the alarms to MQTT Broker in case errors are detected with the time stamp. Refer to chapter "Real time alarm message format." of document MQTT Interface .
adr-10406: Clock synchronization of the module will be done through synchronisation in UNIX-UTC timing provided by thingstream server. . This clock will be synchronized regularly.
